critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage and visible focus pass for all tested header and thesis controls; touch targets report no violations; reduced-motion produces zero animations or changed elements; and no uncontained viewport overflow was measured. However, axe reports a serious incomplete ARIA finding at every viewport: aria-label is applied to a div without a valid role. Contrast also remains unverified for 3 thesis nodes on desktop, 4 on tablet, and 12 header links on mobile. Mobile thesis scrollWidth is 435px against a 390px viewport, although the measured excess is clipped decoration. Missing resolved contrast and semantic proof prevents an 8.
critique.fix: Give the comparison container valid semantics, such as role="group" with aria-labelledby, or remove the unsupported aria-label. Replace overlapping/gradient backgrounds during testing or manually measure every flagged foreground/background pair and meet WCAG AA. Constrain the mobile decorative inset so the section scrollWidth stays at 390px, then rerun axe, keyboard, touch-target, overflow, and reduced-motion checks with no serious incomplete results.
